title: Why it sucks being a KAA Gent fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... KAA Gent fan!
It starts when you're six. Your friends support Barça or Real Madrid. You support... the Buffalos. Nobody knows why. Something about a circus in 1906.
Age eight. A local kid plays in your youth team. Kevin De Bruyne. At fourteen, he leaves. For Genk. Then he becomes one of the best players in the world.
Age twelve. You win the league! For the first time. Ever. After more than a hundred years.
Age thirteen. Champions League! Last sixteen! Your friend says: "Congrats, Genk!" It's Gent.
Age fifteen. You finish top of the table. Then Belgium cuts everyone's points in half. Welcome to the play-offs.
Age seventeen. Cup final against Anderlecht. Penalties. You win! Your friend texts: "Well done, Genk!"
That's the thing about being a Gent fan. Nobody spells it right.
But you know exactly who you are. The Buffalos.
Tag a Gent fan. Not a Genk fan. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
